name: two_pi_wrong
subs: const float theta = fdivv(a, fmul(a, (float)angle, two_pi), turn);
const float theta = fdivv(a, fmul(a, (float)angle, two_pi + 1.0f), turn);

name: half_angle_div_wrong
subs: const float h = fdivv(a, theta, two);
const float h = fdivv(a, theta, two + 1.0f);

name: half_pi_scale_wrong
subs: const int32_t quadrant = (int32_t)ftrc(fadd(a, fdivv(a, h, half_pi), half));
const int32_t quadrant = (int32_t)ftrc(fadd(a, fdivv(a, h, half_pi * 2.0f), half));

name: quadrant_half_missing
subs: const int32_t quadrant = (int32_t)ftrc(fadd(a, fdivv(a, h, half_pi), half));
const int32_t quadrant = (int32_t)ftrc(fadd(a, fdivv(a, h, half_pi), 0.0f));

name: y_reduction_wrong
subs: const float y = fsub(a, h, fmul(a, (float)quadrant, half_pi));
const float y = fsub(a, h, fmul(a, (float)quadrant, two_pi));

name: cf_numerator_wrong
subs: frac = fdivv(a, y_sq, fsub(a, (float)k, frac));
frac = fdivv(a, y, fsub(a, (float)k, frac));

name: cf_end_wrong
subs: for (int k = 11; k >= 3; k -= 2)
for (int k = 11; k >= 5; k -= 2)

name: cf_step_wrong
subs: for (int k = 11; k >= 3; k -= 2)
for (int k = 11; k >= 3; k -= 1)

name: t_denom_wrong
subs: const float t = fdivv(a, y, fsub(a, 1.0f, frac));
const float t = fdivv(a, y, fsub(a, 1.0f, frac + 1.0f));

name: two_times_wrong
subs: const float sine = fdivv(a, fmul(a, t, two), denom);
const float sine = fdivv(a, fmul(a, t, two + 1.0f), denom);

name: quadrant_sign_wrong
subs: F(0) = (quadrant & 1) ? -sine : sine;
F(0) = (quadrant & 1) ? sine : -sine;

name: cos_fold_wrong
subs: if (angle > 0x8000u) angle = 0x10000u - angle;
if (angle > 0x8000u) angle = 0x08000u - angle;

name: cos_sub_wrong
subs: R(4) = 0x4000u - angle;
R(4) = 0x8000u - angle;
